digest.component_or_area: Ruff RUF rule family linter configuration and enforcement
propositions: 142 actionable RUF diagnostics (excluding RUF001/002/003/100) exist at baseline commit 0f5dbc88b and must be remediated across src/rebar and tests before enabling RUF selection
pyproject.toml must configure [tool.ruff.lint].ignore to exactly [RUF001, RUF002, RUF003] with no extend-ignore key to defer Unicode-related rules while enabling the rest of the RUF family

tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py must assert RUF is in [tool.ruff.lint].select and verify the ignore deferral is exact and per-file-ignores contains no RUF codes to prevent broad or code-specific RUF exemptions
ruff check --select RUF --ignore RUF001,RUF002,RUF003,RUF100 src/rebar tests must exit 0 after mechanical remediation of the baseline 142 diagnostics
ruff check src tests must exit 0 under the final full configured rule set to confirm RUF100 suppressions are not stale and no residual RUF violations remain
